name: Outbound webhooks

requirements.text: An authenticated workspace owner or admin can create, update, disable, delete, and rotate a webhook for selected events.
Creation and every delivery attempt require HTTPS and fresh public-address validation without redirects.
Each persisted consented analytics event creates a delivery record and queued job.
The immutable envelope includes schema version, event UUID/name/time, workspace ID, and minimal resource data.
Deliveries retain revision, attempts, state, response code, bounded response excerpt/failure detail, and completion time.
Delivery allows three total attempts with 60-second and 300-second retries, strict timeouts, and 2xx-only success.
Webhook mutation cancels pending deliveries while preserving history; secrets are encrypted and shown only on create/rotate.
Workspace owners and admins can manually redeliver eligible attempts and inspect endpoint health.
Manual redelivery creates immutable lineage from a failed/cancelled delivery and uses the current endpoint revision and secret.
A successful retry clears stale failure detail and response excerpt while preserving the delivery attempt count and terminal history record.

externalPrerequisites: Public HTTPS recipient endpoint for live delivery proof

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every attempt re-resolves and pins an allowed public destination while retaining TLS hostname validation.
Exact serialized bytes and signature remain stable across automatic retries.
Payloads contain immutable event workspace identity and no raw visitor, destination, access-code, hash, or secret data.

observedBehaviors: The webhook list exposes endpoint state, event subscription, delivery volume, overflow actions, and creation.
Webhook and API-key settings form a distinct Developer navigation group.

implementationEvidence.description: Consented direct-link events enqueue deliveries; retries clear stale failure data; response excerpts stay within the configured byte limit on UTF-8 boundaries; projections label the matching latest attempt.
implementationEvidence.reference: tests/Feature/Webhooks/WebhookDeliveryTest.php (including split-boundary UTF-8 byte-bound regression); tests/Feature/Analytics/AnalyticsTrackingTest.php; php artisan test (168 tests, 10,347 assertions)

implementationEvidence.description: The canonical /account-settings/webhooks page rendered without horizontal overflow at 390px; History showed the seeded failed delivery's event, failed state, three attempts, HTTP 503, failure detail, and bounded response excerpt. The fixture was local; no live delivery was sent.
The final isolated Laravel suite passed 475 tests and 16,100 assertions with one conditional skip, including webhook delivery, retry, redelivery, and event-consent coverage.
